narration.text: Helm replaces a stack of monthly subscriptions with one application, one database, and no recurring bill.

scenes.title: What is Helm?
scenes.body: A self-hosted business operating system for exactly one person.

narration.text: Six modules share one SQLite database. Tracked time becomes an invoice line, an invoice payment becomes a bank transaction, and an overdue invoice sits in the same alert list as a failed social post.
It works fully offline. Every integration is optional, and each one degrades to a manual workflow rather than disappearing.

scenes.title: Offline first
scenes.body: No account, no telemetry, no third party holding your data.

narration.text: Clone the repository, run npm install and npm start, then open localhost port four thousand. The first account you create is the only account it will ever have.

scenes.title: Getting started
scenes.body: npm install && npm run setup && npm start
